text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... It's finally! It's finally 
here!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's burdock salad with special 
dressing! Root vegetables are perfect for 
cleaning out your stomach!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Tofu hamburger steak! Packed with 
protein and healthy to boot!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
A grilled mackerel and ten-grain rice set 
meal! Getting dietary fiber and DHA all at 
once is the absolute best!!
choice_data_list: So, which one are you eating?
So, which one are you going to eat?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Which one? Hehehe... I've been saving up 
my appetite just for today. Naturally—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to health food, you're 
looking at Tsuyoshi!! There's no way I can 
pass this up!!
choice_data_list:
No, no! Even healthy food is bad if you 
eat too much!

I see... In that case, have at it to your 
heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh... R-Really? But it's packed full of 
healthy nutrientsâ

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
choice_data_list: Too much of a good thing can be poisonous.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yes. Indeed. Eat until you're eighty 
percent full. I shall have just the right 
amount.

After that, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi made good 
choices with health food, enjoying a 
well-balanced diet.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
My stomach condition is in top form too! 
I'm starving, so I can eat as much as 
you've got!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Here we go! Off to the World of Healthy 
Food~!!

After that, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi savored the 
vast world of health food to her heart's 
content.
